---
title: "Data preprocessing"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

## Read data

```{r}
# combining all the csv files in one data frame
#------------------------------------------

# make a list of file names
file_names <- dir("data/data_raw/")

# add "data/data_raw/" to the beginning of all file names
text_to_add <- "data/data_raw/"
file_names <- lapply(file_names, function(x) paste(text_to_add,x, sep = ""))

# combine all the csvs in one data frame
data_frame <- do.call(bind_rows,lapply(file_names,read.csv))

```

## Clean up data frame

```{r}
# removing unwanted columns and rows in the data frame
# -----------------------------------------------------

# removing columns
data_frame <- data_frame %>% select(-trial_type, -participant_finish_code, -internal_node_id, -question_order)

# removing rows (fixation and masking)
values_to_remove <- c("<p style='font-size:48px'>+</p>", "<p style='font-size:48px'>############<br>############<br>############</p>"
)
data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  filter(!stimulus %in% values_to_remove)

# filling demographic information to every row for each participant
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# converting empty strings to NA in demographic columns
columns_to_convert <- c("language", "education")

data_frame_with_na <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(columns_to_convert), ~na_if(.x, "")))


# filling each participant's demographic information into all rows with the same participant ID
columns_to_fill <- c("age", "language", "education")

data_frame_filled <- data_frame_with_na %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(columns_to_fill), ~ifelse(is.na(.), first(.[!is.na(.)]), .)))

# moving rows up or down to align for each trial
# -----------------------------------------------

# shifting the information in the Ychange-Nchange-column one row down
original_values <- data_frame_filled$Ychange_Nchange_response

data_frame_filled$Ychange_Nchange_response <- c(NA, head(original_values, -1))

# filling sentence id information to every row for every trial
# -------------------------------------------------------------

# converting empty strings to NA in id columns
columns_to_convert2 <- c("sentence_id", "sentence_id_specific")

data_frame_with_na2 <- data_frame_filled %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(columns_to_convert2), ~na_if(.x, "")))

# fill
data_frame_filled2 <- data_frame_with_na2 %>%
  fill(all_of(columns_to_convert2), .direction = "up")

# making rt columns
# ------------------
data_frame_filled2 <- data_frame_filled2 %>%
  group_by(sentence_id_specific) %>%
  mutate(rt_sentence_1 = first(rt),
         rt_sentence_2 = nth(rt,2)) %>%
  ungroup()
```


## Save preprocessed data

```{r}
# specifying file path
file_path <- "data/data_preprocessed/data.csv"

# saving the data frame as a csv
write.csv(data_frame_filled2, file = file_path, row.names = FALSE)
```
